## Opinion: TSMC vs. ASML — Comparing 10-Year Investment Cases in Foundry vs. Semiconductor Equipment

The TSM vs. ASML comparison is perennially relevant for a tech PM because both names offer semiconductor exposure with very different risk profiles — ASML is a near-monopoly capital equipment supplier with pricing power and order visibility, while TSM is exposed to geopolitical risk but captures demand across all advanced-node chip designers. The appearance of this comparison piece may signal growing investor debate about which entry point is more attractive given current valuations.

- Two outlets run an opinion piece directly comparing TSMC and ASML as long-term investment vehicles over a 10-year horizon.
- The framing is foundry manufacturing (TSM) versus capital equipment supply (ASML) — two distinct positions in the semiconductor value chain.
- No financial data, earnings updates, or company-specific news appear in the headlines; this is editorial/opinion content.
